# Verifier hash work

Verifier hashes = authentication (leaf + parent) + H2F + Fiat–Shamir hash/XOF finalizations. A long XOF stream counts as one finalization until new data are absorbed. Input/output bytes are reported separately; these totals are not compression calls or verifier-time estimates. FS adds zero proof bytes; no proof of work is used. Cached public protocol/session ID construction is setup, while their 96-byte absorption is included. WHIR uses a composed transcript model; Bolt is trace-validated. See [the accounting specification and validation](../gf256_batched_suite/fiat_shamir/README.md).
